verdict: Destined Rivals is holding value better: DR25 95.75 vs AH26 93.88 since the Aug 24 launch at 100.00 (Sep 21 mark; no Sep 28 mark in data/indices.json at read time); both fell in the latest week (−2.0% vs −3.1%, AH26's third straight fall). Ascended Heroes has the far bigger chase cards (top three sold-comp medians sum $2,232.00 vs $756.28). On Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex SIR, Destined Rivals #231 $420.50 (30 sales, Sep 17–28) beats Ascended Heroes #281 $252.50 (30 sales, Sep 14–28). Destined Rivals is the cheaper sealed entry: ETB lowest ask $115.00 vs $158.99, booster bundle $50.99 vs $72.15 (Sep 28); DR factory booster box lowest ask $429.99 (4 live), no AH factory box listing.

sources.asks: /api/comps category 183456, read 2026-09-28; lows after filtering cases, lots, multi-box, single packs, damaged boxes, loose-pack box equivalents, foreign-language and Pokémon Center listings by title (ETB 23 / 16 survived of 30 / 24; bundles 23 / 36 of 50 read, 327 / 412 matched; DR factory 36-pack display 4 live). The DR ETB low ($115.00) is a listing whose title says '2026 REPRINT' — no maker reprint statement read, none claimed.
